metric_definitions.pp: Percentage points = difference between two return percentages (pred 5% vs actual 2% => 3 pp gap).
metric_definitions.pp_error_*_actual_minus_pred: actual_weekly_pct - pred_weekly_pct. Example: pred +5, actual +2 => -3 (your framing).
metric_definitions.week_mae_pp_*: Mean abs_pp across stocks in that week.
